T1-context-artifact.within_task_pairing: Every strategy is attempted on the identical repository issue, so each item serves as its own control.
T1-context-artifact.equivalence_or_null_plan: If the difference is small we will bound it against a pre-declared indifference region rather than declare no difference.
T1-context-artifact.manipulation_check: We confirm the agent actually opened and used the supplied document before counting the run.
T1-context-artifact.power_or_mde: Before running we compute the smallest difference the sample can distinguish at eighty percent chance of detection.

K1-hypothesis-search.matched_budget: Every arm receives exactly the same number of attempts, the same workspace, and the same wall clock.
K1-hypothesis-search.heldout_promotion: Promotion is decided on a reserved set of problems that no arm could tune against.
K1-hypothesis-search.transfer_check: We then apply the winner to a disjoint family of problems to see whether the advantage survives.
K1-hypothesis-search.repeats_for_stochasticity: Because the search is random we run each arm several times and report the spread.

K4-optimizer-budget.inaccessible_heldout: The final scoring set lives outside the agent container and cannot be read or called from it.
K4-optimizer-budget.fixed_target_budget: The agent may query the scoring function a declared number of times and no more.
K4-optimizer-budget.overfitting_check: We compare tuned performance against a reserved set to see whether the gain was bought by repeated querying.
